# Import metadata file

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
dogskin_metadata_tsv <- read_tsv("../CH-All_16S_Metadata_20220124.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Collection_Cat = case_when(
    #Collection_Cat %in% c(3, 4) ~ "3-4",
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
 
SAMPLE_SPACING <- 1.6        
POINT_SIZE     <- 7         
PLOT_HEIGHT    <- 25           
PLOT_WIDTH     <- 16            

# Data prep
# For each dog, collection sample information at each timepoint 
# === Create analysis-ready dogskin subset ===
dogskin_subset <- dogskin_metadata_tsv |>
  # Select core columns
  select(Dog_ID, Collection_Cat, Surgery_Type, Sample_Site) |>
  
  # Filter to relevant combinations
  filter(
    Sample_Site %in% c("Surgical", "Control", "Air"),
    Surgery_Type %in% c("Abdomen", "Stifle")
  ) |>
  
  # Order Sample_Site for consistent plotting (Control → Air → Surgical)
  mutate(
    Sample_Site = factor(Sample_Site, levels = c("Control", "Air", "Surgical")),
    Collection_Cat = factor(Collection_Cat, 
                           levels = c("Admission", "Day 1", "Day 3", 
                                     "Pre Surgery", "Surgery", "Post Surgery", 
                                     "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4", 
                                     "Week 5", "Week 6"))
  ) |>
  
  # Deduplicate (keep first per group)
  group_by(Dog_ID, Collection_Cat, Surgery_Type, Sample_Site) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

# First: compute total samples per dog (across sample sites)
dog_sample_counts <- dogskin_subset |>
  group_by(Dog_ID, Surgery_Type) |>
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Surgery_Type, n_samples) # surgery first, then sample count 

# Now set dog_order as the sorted dog IDs
dog_order <- dog_sample_counts$Dog_ID

# Keep n_samples attached to dogskin_subset for plotting labels
dogskin_subset <- dogskin_subset |>
  left_join(dog_sample_counts, by = c("Dog_ID", "Surgery_Type"))


timepoints <- sort(unique(dogskin_subset$Collection_Cat))
sites     <- c("Control", "Air", "Surgical")
n_dogs    <- length(unique(dogskin_subset$Dog_ID))

# Complete grid - 60 rows total (3 per dog), ORDERED by Surgery_Type
complete_grid <- expand_grid(
  Dog_ID         = dog_order,
  Collection_Cat = timepoints,
  Sample_Site    = sites
) |>
  left_join(dogskin_subset, by = c("Dog_ID", "Collection_Cat", "Sample_Site")) |>
  # First: set Present and Dot_Color at the same time
  mutate(
    Present   = !is.na(Surgery_Type),
    Dot_Color = case_when(
      !Present                            ~ "white",
      Present & Sample_Site == "Surgical" ~ "blue",
      Present & Sample_Site == "Air"      ~ "limegreen",
      Present & Sample_Site == "Control"  ~ "purple",
      TRUE                                ~ "white"
    ),
    # Surgery‑type bar color
    Bar_Color = case_when(
      Surgery_Type == "Abdomen" ~ "orange",
      Surgery_Type == "Stifle"  ~ "pink"
    ),
    # Factor levels for ordering and matching
    Sample_Site = factor(Sample_Site, levels = sites),
    Dot_Color   = factor(Dot_Color, levels = c("blue", "limegreen", "purple", "white"))
  ) |>
  mutate(Y_Pos = (match(Dog_ID, dog_order) - 1) * 3 + 
         match(Sample_Site, sites) - 1) 

# Vertical blocks for surgery‑type background bars
VERTICAL_BLOCK_SIZE <- 3
dog_bars <- complete_grid |>
  distinct(Dog_ID, Surgery_Type, Bar_Color) |>
  mutate(
    Y_Base = (match(Dog_ID, dog_order) - 1) * VERTICAL_BLOCK_SIZE - 0.6,
    Y_Top  = (match(Dog_ID, dog_order) - 1) * VERTICAL_BLOCK_SIZE + 2.6,
    xmin   = 1,   # First categorical position
    xmax   = length(levels(timepoints))  # Last categorical position
  )

dog_bars <- dog_bars |> 
  filter(!is.na(Bar_Color))

# Black lines defining boundaries
black_sep_y       <- seq(2.6, 
                         (length(dog_order) - 1) * VERTICAL_BLOCK_SIZE + 2.6, 
                         VERTICAL_BLOCK_SIZE)
bottom_line_y     <- -0.6
black_sep_y_full  <- c(bottom_line_y, black_sep_y)
sample_y_pos      <- sort(unique(complete_grid$Y_Pos))

# 60 labels: Surgical–Air–Control repeated for each dog (top→bottom)
sample_labels <- rep(c("Control", "Air", "Surgical"), length(dog_order))

# Left‑side labels with colors
sample_df <- data.frame(
  y     = sample_y_pos,
  label = sample_labels,
  Site  = rep(c("Control", "Air", "Surgical"), length(dog_order))
)

# Dog labels with n_samples underneath
dog_labels <- paste0("Dog ", dog_sample_counts$Dog_ID, "\n(", dog_sample_counts$n_samples, ")")

# Gray gridlines
gray_grid_y <- sample_y_pos

# === Construct the sampling regimen plot ===
# === Fixed plot for categorical Collection_Cat ===
p <- ggplot(complete_grid, aes(x = Collection_Cat, y = Y_Pos)) +

  # 1. Background dog bars
  geom_rect(
    data = dog_bars, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = Y_Base, ymax = Y_Top, fill = Bar_Color),
    alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5
  ) +

  # 2. Grid lines (unchanged)
  geom_hline(data = data.frame(yintercept = gray_grid_y), 
             aes(yintercept = yintercept), color = "gray80", size = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(data = data.frame(yintercept = black_sep_y_full), 
             aes(yintercept = yintercept), color = "black", size = 1.0) +

  # 3. Points (unchanged)
  geom_point(aes(fill = Dot_Color), shape = 21, size = POINT_SIZE, 
             stroke = 0.8, color = "gray") +

  # 4. Y-axis (unchanged)
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, (length(dog_order)-1)*3 + 1, 3),
                     labels = dog_labels, name = "") +

  # 5. Sample labels (fixed x position)
  geom_text(data = sample_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(y = y, label = label), 
            x = -2,  # Left of categorical axis
            hjust = 0.5, size = 6, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +

  # 6. Fill scale (unchanged)
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Surgery / Sample Type",
    values = c("orange" = "orange", "pink" = "pink", 
               "blue" = "blue", "limegreen" = "limegreen", 
               "purple" = "purple", "white" = "white"),
    labels = c("orange" = "Abdomen", "pink" = "Stifle",
               "blue" = "Surgical", "limegreen" = "Air", 
               "purple" = "Control", "white" = "Missing")
  ) +

  # 7. **FIXED: Categorical X-axis**
  scale_x_discrete(  # ← Use discrete for categorical!
    name = "Collection Day"
  ) +

  # 8. Theme (unchanged)
  labs(title = "Sampling Regimen") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  # === Updated theme for maximum label visibility ===
theme(
  legend.position = "bottom", 
  legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18), 
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
  
  # Y-axis: Large bold dog labels + right margin for sample-site labels
  axis.text.y = element_text(
    hjust = 0.5, 
    size = 20, 
    face = "bold", 
    margin = margin(r = 25)  # Space for sample-site labels
  ),
  
  # X-axis: 90° rotation + right alignment to see ALL labels
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90, 
    hjust = 1,      # Right-align rotated labels
    vjust = 0.5,    # Center vertically
    size = 18
  ),
  
  # MASSIVE right margin for sample labels + left for x-axis
  plot.margin = margin(30, 30, 30, 30, "pt"),  # Increased right margin
  
  plot.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
)

  # 9. **FIXED: Discrete limits**
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, max(black_sep_y_full) - 2),
                  xlim = c(0.8, length(levels(complete_grid$Collection_Cat)) + 0.2))

print(p)

ggsave("16S_dog_sampling_regimen.png", p, width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT, dpi = 300)


```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Data prep  
dogskin_subset <- dogskin_metadata_tsv |>
  select(Dog_ID, Sex, Weight_kg, Age_Years, Surgery_Type) |>
  filter(Surgery_Type %in% c("Abdomen", "Stifle")) |>
  mutate(
    Weight_kg = as.numeric(Weight_kg),
    Age_Years = as.numeric(Age_Years)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Sex = ifelse(is.na(Sex), "Missing", Sex),
    Surgery_Type = factor(Surgery_Type, levels = c("Stifle", "Abdomen"))
  ) |>
  group_by(Dog_ID, Sex, Weight_kg, Age_Years, Surgery_Type) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

# Missing summary
missing_summary <- dogskin_subset %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(Sex, Weight_kg, Age_Years), ~ sum(is.na(.))),
    .by = Surgery_Type
  )
print("Missing value counts by surgery type:")
print(missing_summary)

# Boxplot data
plot_data <- dogskin_subset %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age_Years), !is.na(Weight_kg)) %>%
  select(Surgery_Type, Age_Years, Weight_kg) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Age_Years, Weight_kg), 
               names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Variable = recode_factor(Variable, 
                                  Age_Years = "Age (years)",
                                  Weight_kg = "Weight (kg)"))

# 1. Clean boxplots
p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Surgery_Type, y = Value, fill = Surgery_Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "black", 
               outlier.size = 1.5, width = 0.10, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stifle" = "pink", "Abdomen" = "orange"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Dog Characteristics by Surgical Group", 
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Boxplots: median +/- IQR | Dots: individual dogs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10, color = "gray40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# 2. Clean sex bars
p2 <- ggplot(dogskin_subset, aes(x = Surgery_Type, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9, color = "white", 
           size = 0.8, width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "lightcyan", "Female" = "lightsalmon", 
                               "Missing" = "#999999"), 
                    name = "Sex") +
  labs(x = "Surgery Type", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Combine and export
combined_plot <- p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))

print(combined_plot)

# Publication exports
ggsave("dog_characteristics.png", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 6.5, 
       dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(readr)

# === Load and preprocess 16S metadata ===
dogskin_metadata_tsv <- read_tsv("../CH-All_16S_Metadata_20220124.tsv") %>%
    select(Dog_ID, Collection_Day, DNA_Conc, Surgery_Type, Sample_Site) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Dog_ID),
    !is.na(Collection_Day),
    Sample_Site %in% c("Surgical", "Control")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DNA_Conc = as.numeric(DNA_Conc),
    Collection_Day = case_when(Collection_Day %in% c(3, 4) ~ "3",
                               TRUE ~ as.character(Collection_Day)) %>%
                     fct_inorder()
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dog_ID, Collection_Day, DNA_Conc, Sample_Site) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# === Sort metadata ===
dogskin_metadata_sorted <- dogskin_metadata_tsv %>%
  arrange(Collection_Day, Sample_Site, desc(DNA_Conc)) %>%
  mutate(
    Dog_ID = factor(Dog_ID, levels = unique(Dog_ID)),
    Collection_Day_Site = paste(Collection_Day, Sample_Site, sep = "_")
  )

# === Helper function for Subset Creation ===
prepare_subset <- function(data, site_filter) {
  data %>%
    filter(Sample_Site == site_filter) %>%
    group_by(Collection_Day) %>%
    arrange(desc(DNA_Conc)) %>%
    mutate(Dog_ID = fct_inorder(factor(Dog_ID))) %>%
    ungroup()
}

surgical_data <- prepare_subset(dogskin_metadata_tsv, "Surgical")
control_data  <- prepare_subset(dogskin_metadata_tsv, "Control")

# === Shared y-axis scaling ===
y_max <- max(c(surgical_data$DNA_Conc, control_data$DNA_Conc), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

# === Plot function for consistent styling ===
plot_16S <- function(data, title, fill_var, fill_values) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Collection_Day, y = DNA_Conc, fill = !!sym(fill_var))) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
             color = "white", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.9, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "DNA concentration after PCR (pre-normalization)",
      x = "Collection Day",
      y = "DNA Conc (ng/µL)",
      fill = gsub("_", " ", fill_var)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}

# === Plot by sample site (Surgery Type comparison) ===
p_surgical <- plot_16S(
  surgical_data,
  "Abdomen vs. Stifle: Surgical Site 16S DNA Concentration",
  "Surgery_Type",
  c("Abdomen" = "#E69F00", "Stifle" = "#CC79A7")
)

p_control <- plot_16S(
  control_data,
  "Abdomen vs. Stifle: Control Site 16S DNA Concentration",
  "Surgery_Type",
  c("Abdomen" = "#E69F00", "Stifle" = "#CC79A7")
)

print(p_surgical)
print(p_control)

ggsave("16S_DNA_Conc_Surgical.png", p_surgical, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("16S_DNA_Conc_Control.png",  p_control,  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# === Plot by surgery type (Site comparison) ===
stifle_data <- dogskin_metadata_tsv %>%
  filter(Surgery_Type == "Stifle") %>%
  group_by(Collection_Day) %>%
  arrange(desc(DNA_Conc)) %>%
  mutate(Dog_ID = fct_inorder(factor(Dog_ID))) %>%
  ungroup()

abdomen_data <- dogskin_metadata_tsv %>%
  filter(Surgery_Type == "Abdomen") %>%
  group_by(Collection_Day) %>%
  arrange(desc(DNA_Conc)) %>%
  mutate(Dog_ID = fct_inorder(factor(Dog_ID))) %>%
  ungroup()

y_max <- max(dogskin_metadata_tsv$DNA_Conc, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

p_stifle <- plot_16S(
  stifle_data,
  "Stifle Surgery: 16S DNA Concentration by Sample Site",
  "Sample_Site",
  c("Surgical" = "blue", "Control" = "purple", "Air" = "limegreen")
)

p_abdomen <- plot_16S(
  abdomen_data,
  "Abdomen Surgery: 16S DNA Concentration by Sample Site",
  "Sample_Site",
  c("Surgical" = "blue", "Control" = "purple", "Air" = "limegreen")
)

print(p_stifle)
print(p_abdomen)

ggsave("16S_DNA_Conc_Stifle.png",  p_stifle,  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("16S_DNA_Conc_Abdomen.png", p_abdomen, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```



```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}


# === Load and preprocess metadata ===
dogskin_metadata_tsv <- read_tsv("../CH-All_16S_Metadata_20220124.tsv") %>%
  select(Dog_ID, Collection_Day, DNA_Conc, Surgery_Type, Sample_Site) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Dog_ID),
    !is.na(Collection_Day),
    Sample_Site %in% c("Surgical", "Control")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DNA_Conc = as.numeric(DNA_Conc),
    Collection_Day = case_when(Collection_Day %in% c(3, 4) ~ "3",
                               TRUE ~ as.character(Collection_Day)) %>%
                     fct_inorder()
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dog_ID, Collection_Day, DNA_Conc, Sample_Site) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# === Per-dog plotting function (Surgical = Surgery_Type color, Control = gray) ===
plot_dog_ITS <- function(dog_data, dog_id) {
  y_max <- max(dog_data$DNA_Conc, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  
  ggplot(dog_data, aes(x = Collection_Day, y = DNA_Conc, fill = Sample_Site)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      color = "white", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.8, alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Surgical" = "gray50",  # Dynamic: overridden below per dog
        "Control" = "gray80"
      )
    ) +
    # Override Surgical color based on dog's Surgery_Type
    {
      dog_surgery <- unique(dog_data$Surgery_Type)
      surgical_color <- if(dog_surgery == "Abdomen") "#E69F00" else "#CC79A7"
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Surgical" = surgical_color, "Control" = "gray80"),
        name = "Sample Site",
        labels = c("Surgical" = paste(dog_surgery, "Surgical"), "Control" = "Control")
      )
    } +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Dog", dog_id, "-", unique(dog_data$Surgery_Type)),
      subtitle = "16S DNA concentration after PCR (pre-normalization)",
      x = "Collection Day",
      y = "DNA Conc (ng/µL)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
}

# === Create and save individual plots ===
unique_dogs <- unique(dogskin_metadata_tsv$Dog_ID)

for(dog_id in unique_dogs) {
  dog_data <- dogskin_metadata_tsv %>%
    filter(Dog_ID == dog_id)
  
  p <- plot_dog_ITS(dog_data, dog_id)
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("16S_DNA_Conc_Dog_", dog_id, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300
  )
}

cat("Created", length(unique_dogs), "individual dog plots!\n")


```
